page.layout: Running head at top centre; page number at top right. Two circular woodcut medallions side by side, with inscriptions around the rims (left: ADAM; right: HEVA and ADAM). Below them one column of running text, two paragraphs. No marginal notes, no footnotes, no catchword.

main_text.l: DOCET nos sacra scriptura quemadmodum in principio
creauerit Deus cœlum & terram: atque vt sexto die formauit
hominem (Adam inquam ac Euam) ad imaginem & similitu-
dinem suam: deinde vt Adamo collocato in terrestri paradiso,
prohibuerit,cum interminatione mortis, de ligno scientiæ bo-
ni & mali edere. At verò à serpente decepta prima mulier,man-
datum transgressa,de fructu vetito edit: ac virum suum protoplastum ad edendum illexit:quare
statim sub iugum peccati & mortis traditi sunt: atque è paradiso illo semper virente,&
sponte omnia ferente eiecti,in terram execratam,in quâ labo-
ribus & sudoribus infinitis vitam transigerent. Adam itaque
terram exercuit:Euam vxorem cognouit,quæ peperit illi Cain,
deinde Abel, qui à fratre Cain per inuidiam occisus est. Gen.
ADAM annos natus 130. genuit Seth,à quo patres pietate
insignes originem traxere. Seth natus annos 105. genuit Enos:
hic cœpit inuocare nomen Domini. Enos,annorum 90.genuit
Cainam. Cainam annorum 70. genuit Malaleel. Malaleel an-
norum 65.genuit Iared. Iared annorum 162. genuit Henoch.
Henoch annorum 65. genuit Mathusalam. Porrò Henoch an-
nos natus 365, sublatus est à Deo, nec apparuit. Mathusala an-
norum 187.genuit Lamech. Lamech annorum 182. genuit
Noe. Noe annorum 500. genuit Sem,Cham & Iaphet,100.an-
nis ante diluuium. Erat itaque 600.annorum Noe tempore di-
luuij. Obiit Adam anno ætatis suæ 930. Vide Gene.cap.5.&7.

page.notes: Two woodcut medallions above the text are engravings, not printed text: left, a bearded man labelled ADAM; right, a figure labelled HEVA · VX · and ADAM. Their inscriptions are described here only. Page number "5" at top right is slightly unclear, marked [?]. Faint show-through from the reverse side is visible in the lower half and was left out. The first word of the page, DOCET, is set in capitals and is not a heading.
